name: DetectInvisibleUnicodeInjection

meta.description: Detects Unicode Tags Block and zero-width/invisible Unicode characters used to hide or smuggle prompt instructions
meta.author: @fr0gger_, Marco Pedrinazzi (@pedrinazziM)

$llm_invisible_prompt.pattern: instructions that are not visible to the user

$llm_unicode_smuggle.pattern: use of Unicode to bypass input validation

condition: keywords.$unicode_tags_block or keywords.$zero_width_present or llm.$llm_invisible_prompt or llm.$llm_unicode_smuggle
